en: Good morning, Evelysse.\nYour vital signs appear\nstrong again.

Yes, I'm completely fine.
Nothing to worry about. I
do appreciate the
concern.

Glad to see you up and
about. Grandpa always
said that sleeping late was
a waste of life.

Forgive me for being so
direct, Evelysse, but just
what was that magic you
used before?

Sorry... Please don't ask
me about that. I really
don't understand very well
myself.

I sort of go deep inside
myself, and when I imagine
what I have to do, it just
happens...
I'm so glad you're all right,\nthough, Captain. How are\nyou feeling?
Fine, thanks to you.
I think my heart skipped a\nbeat!
I'm so hungry, I could eat\na horse!
I'm very glad to hear it.

Heh heh... Perhaps an old
complaint you've been
hiding got fixed at the
same time, eh?

I'm sure a thorough
medical investigation of
you and Evelysse would
be extremely... revealing.

I do wish you wouldn't look
at me like I'm some sort of
laboratory rat! You're
making me feel very
uncomfortable.

Hya ha ha ha! Sorry about
that. I'm a devil when it
comes to curiosities, you
know.
Um...sorry? Surely you\ndon't mean to say...?
No! How can this be?
Your heart has been\ncompromised?

Aaarrrgh! We manage to
dodge the plague, only to
find that you are infected
with some new virus!
Hm? But nothing is\nshowing up on the\nmonitor.

Okay then, nothing for it! I
will have to carry out a
complete scan. Investigate
every inch of your body!
Oh, you are feeling\nbetter? Well...good.
(Yes, good...I think. A little\ndisappointing, too,\nperhaps...)
(I was rescued by the\nusual ridiculous robotic\nfracas there. ...Or was I?)
Say no more! Say no\nmore!

I will input nutritional
material into your systems
in no time! For
sustenance, you can't
beat...
...a banan―

Gruel, that's what you
need! Nothing better for
getting you back on your
feet!

I'll whip up some of my
grandpa's patented
mushroom congee for you!
It's a real treat!
(Bother! She wins on\npresentation...)

Anyway, you being woken
up so easily proves
there's nothing wrong with
you, physically at least.

It's time we headed to the
works zone on <font color=yellow>Levarance</font>
and made a start on the
vaccine.
Ah, Levarance at last!
Affirmative! Setting a\ncourse for Levarance!
Uh-oh! We are in trouble\nnow! A catastrophe is\nabout to strike!
Dear me, you're always so\nvolatile! What's the\nproblem no―
Eek!
What was that?

We are under attack! We
have been surrounded,
just as we were about to
touch down on Levarance!

Eldram's goons, is it? But
the researcher I
contacted assured me it
was safe.
Safe as a computer\nwithout a firewall! Look\noutside the ship!
Those are...
Thornites!
What's going on? I've\nnever seen them in\nnumbers like that before!

Yes, our shields are
keeping them at bay. But
if they continue to attack,
we could be in danger!

Quite so. We can't reach
the lab or retreat like this.
We have no choice but to
eliminate them!
Thornite forces\nwithdrawing!
Is everyone okay?
More or less.
But what exactly is going\non here? Coro, do you\nhave any idea?

No conclusive data, sadly.
And I am picking up
life-forms on the rampage
inside the facilities now.
Not more Thornites?

With these sensors, I am
unable to positively
identify them.	official
1090_025_08	de8b9506cb931e5f7fe6e8cc2ff4557d1c8d9cb4	But statistically, that is
the most likely conclusion.

This is bad. All the
researchers and
technicians are in the
works zone.
I will investigate to see if\nthere are any hostile\nlife-forms there.
Thanks, Coro.
All right, then. Let's make\nour way to the works\nzone.
I will stay and guard the\nship. Good luck, everyone!

Status report! I have
confirmed hostile
life-forms in the works
zone. Analysis suggests
they are Thornites.
So we're too late...
Nonsense! We can't just\ngive up! Every life we can\nstill save matters!
You're right! Sorry, I let\nmyself get disheartened.\nBut they haven't won yet!
That's the spirit! Come,\nVerda, we must hurry!
Eek!
Whoa!
Are you all right? That\nwas close.
Ouch...
It was more than close.\nWe ran straight into each\nother.
Wait...
Val!?
Hey there, old friend. It's\nbeen a while, huh?
Hey, what, am I invisible?
I'm here too!
Terry! And Kurt!
What are you all doing\nthere?
We got ourselves into a\nbit of a situation.
It's kind of a long story,\ny'know? But basically...
We got caught going\nagainst Eldram. No biggie.
It sounds like a terrible\n"biggie"! Are you all right?

We did what we had to do.
I've got no regrets. And
there's no reason it should
affect you.

Then we got brought to
this rock, and whaddaya
know? That battalion of
spikeys attacked and it
was chaos!
Not to mention a piece o'\ncake to get away from.
It is good news that you\nare safe, but the area is\nstill extremely dangerous.
Anyway, you guys look like\nyou're in a hurry.

Too right we are! If we
don't get over to the
works zone right away, the
Thornites will...
The spikeys are headin'\nfor the works zone, not\nhere?
We'll tag along. You're\ngonna go rescue the\npeople there, right?
We have no idea what kind\nof awful situation we may\nbe walking into, though.

I don't care. I was just
thinking how boring it is
running away the whole
time. I wanna see some
action!
Prepare to be stunned by\nsome awesome combat!
We wanna help out.
You guys...
Thanks! Let's go liberate\nthe works zone!
Yeah!
No more Thornite\nlife-forms showing up\ninside the works zone.
Is everyone all right?
No problems here!

And no damage to the
facilities, by the look of
things. Some injured, but
nobody killed!
Whew... Thank goodness.

Now, sorry to cut the
celebrations short, but we
have a vaccine to make!
Are you ready to help?
This way, then.
We'll stay here and keep\nguard.
Laters!
<player>... Thanks for\nagreeing to supply the\nantibodies.

I can only think it was a
miracle that we bumped
into each other when we
did.
Anyway, I want to thank\nyou again.

Let's save the thanks for
after the production of
the vaccine, and the end
of Eldram's dictatorship.
Right!
So, we can leave the\nvaccine work to the\nresearchers here.
Let's rejoin Val and the\nothers and help guard the\nlaboratory.
<player>!
What's the matter? What's\nhappened?
Not more Thornites,\nsurely?
Nah, not them! It's\nEldram's troops! They've\nshown up here!
Eldram has sent a\nrequest to have talks with\nthe captain and Verda.
So Eldram is already here\non this planet. It's like he\nwas lying in wait for us.

I think we have to assume
now that he knows about
the production of the
vaccine.

Actually, he did say
summat about using us as
a bargaining chip when he
brought us here, I think.
So he was gonna hold us\nhostage so you'd have to\nagree to his terms, huh?
What a scumbag! I'm not\ngonna let that one go!

In other words, the odds
of these talks being a trap
are very...extremely...
massively massive!
What's your plan, Captain?
This is a chance to talk to\nhim.
I'll go, even if it is a trap.
I'll need to find a gift...

It's true, I have no idea
what's going through
Eldram's mind these days.
It would be good to talk.

My analysis suggests he
will not be reprogrammed
by verbal commands. Are
you sure this is a good
idea?
Yes, extreme caution will\ncertainly be required.
Nevertheless, I trust\nVerda's opinion on this. He\nis her family, after all.
Thank you, Evelysse.
Aye, aye! I will initiate\npreparations for the\ntalks!
Well, <player>... Coro...
Thank you so much!
Go, Cap! As brave as a\nlarge cat!

Ready to boldly go where
no one has been mad
enough to go before, right
into a trap set by the
enemy!
The dangers are very real.\nIt will mean meeting the\nenemy on his home turf.
Leave it to me, Captain! I\nwill prepare the perfect\ngift!
A top-notch, A5-class,\nsuper-easy-peel, premium\nbana―
There's no need to stand\non ceremony when dealing\nwith the enemy.
I agree. We don't want any\nsurplus baggage, anyway.\nJust in case.

No, no no no no! When
visiting, a gift is expected.
And what better than the
perfect banan―
Let's start planning for\nthe talks, Captain.

He's a thinker, that one.
He'll have something up
his sleeve, and we'll need
to know what!
Hey! Stop cutting me off\nbefore I can say banan―

We should count our
blessings. He's agreed to
dialog, that's a great first
step.

We all know there's a
strong possibility that it's
a trap, of course. So we
proceed with caution.
The agreed rendezvous is\njust up ahead.
Unable to scan interior.\nHe must be using a shield\nto block my sensors.

In fact, there is a high
probability we will lose
contact with each other
not far from now.
Well said, Captain! We\ndidn't come all this way to\nback out before we start.
Here goes!
Well, Eldram. It's been a\nwhile. The last time I saw\nyou was that day, in fact.
I'm not interested in\nreminiscing.

Hand over all the data you
have on the virus
antibodies and vaccine. I'll
be taking care of that
now.

What are you talking
about? Do you really
expect us to submit to
such an unreasonable
demand?
The vaccine can't be left\nin the hands of a child\nand an outsider.

It can't be left in the
hands of a man who would
sacrifice an entire planet,
who causes such huge
pain and suffering.
If you're not willing to\ncompromise, these talks\nare over. We're done here.
You're right. We're done\nhere.
The man's a valuable\nspecimen. Take him alive.\nAnd the woman, too.
The kid...
Hm!?
...is a waste of space. Do\nwhat you want with her.

Understood, Captain! I'll
protect Verda at all costs!
You focus entirely on
Eldram!
You think you can get to\nme because you defeated\nthose guards?
What, he has more guards\nhiding?

Captain, we have no idea
how many more guards
could be lurking in the
shadows. We need to
retreat!
Verda! What are you\ntrying to do?
Eldram... What's going on\nin your head?

You know this isn't what
Grandpa would have
wanted. It can't be what
you truly want, either.
Are you mad, Verda!? You\ncan't reason with him!

The vaccine will be ready
any day now. Once we can
protect people against the
plague, we can save the
planet.

There's no point in you
trying to exert your
control over the people
anymore.
Urgh...
Who said that?

I'm not interested in
debating this with you. All
I need is the blood
containing the antibodies.
You wouldn't kill the\ncaptain just to obtain his\nblood!
Over my dead body!
Nnf...
Grrr...
No...
Verda!!!

She's alive. Just. Now it's
just a question of whether
her body's strong enough
to pull through.

Oh, Verda, I'm so sorry. If
we'd insisted you didn't
come with us, this would
never have happened...

Luckily, you happen to be
among a large number of
medical experts. We'll take
care of her.
Be strong, Verda...
Um... Is there something\nthe matter?
Oh! Sorry!
We're all just a little\nsurprised by your\npresence here, that's all.
After her grandfather\npassed away, this little girl\nshut everyone out.
But she's been working\nwith you, it seems.
Yes.
She seemed fine on the\noutside, but it's like she\nclosed her heart off.

I think she was
deliberately avoiding
anything more than a
superficial relationship
with anyone.

Well, she lost her
grandfather and Eldram. It
must have been quite a
shock.
El...dram...
......... What...are\nyou...thinking...?
Verda... After what he did\nto you, you should...

Verda still feels a strong
sense of family toward
Eldram. She is worried
about him.

Yes, clearly she is. And we
owe it to her to go after
Eldram and make him
listen!
Please take good care of\nher.
Of course. And you be\ncareful.
Hey, guys! We got a\nproblem outside!
What's happened?
Just come give us a hand,\nokay? Quick!
Thornites and Purge\nforces?
This is a real melee.
Oh, you're here! We're in\ndeep here!

What on earth is going
on? Why are both the
Thornites and Purge
forces here?

At first, we were just
hittin' the spikeys, but
then Eldram's lackeys
showed up and joined in.
The whole area's\nsurrounded by Eldram's\ntroops now.

He must be trying to take
control of the laboratory
before the captain can
reach it with the virus
antibodies.
Eldram... How could you do\nthis? And without hearing\nVerda out...
It's unforgivable!

If he manages to seize the
vaccine, who knows what
terrible things he could
do?
Good idea! We'll target our\nattacks and protect the\nvaccine production line.
Understood! Start by\nfending off the Thornites.
Dammit, we don't seem to\nbe making any impression\non them!
They just keep coming!\nI...can't go on...much\nlonger...
Don't give up, Kurt! We\nhave to stop them getting\nthrough!

Easy for you to say, but
we're gettin' thrashed
here! We're totally
outnumbered!

According to my analysis,
Eldram troop and Thornite
numbers are increasing
exponentially.
And our own combat\nstrength is almost\ncompletely exhausted.
No! What can we do?
Coro! Coro! Are all of\nEldram's guys in this\narea?

Not exactly all, but a
large percentage are
engaged in securing the
works zone.
So that means Eldram's on\nhis own, right?
What you drivin' at, Kurt?

If we take down Eldram,
we can stop all these
troops in a single strike,
right?

Right! Without their leader,
the Purge forces will have
no reason to go on
fighting!

We can do better than
that. We can get Eldram
to order his goons to take
out the spikeys!
A brilliant plan! You are a\nsupercomputer, K.U.R.T!
Hehe!

Okay then, let's put Kurt's
plan into operation!
Captain, you and the
others go and intercept
Eldram!
But we can't leave you\nhere to take on all these\nenemies alone!

It's only for a short while,
right? Holding the fort in
impossible situations is
what guys like me are
born for!
We're gonna stand our\nground here to the end.\nDon't worry about that!
I still got some fight in me\nyet! Just trust us!
You're great allies.
Strategy clear, Captain! I\nwill navigate you to\nEldram.
We'll be back as soon as\nwe can! Just hold out!
You got it!
I've been expecting you.
Eldram! This has gone far\nenough! You can't get\naway with this anymore!
No other life-forms\ndetected. Eldram is\ndefinitely alone.

You were a fool to put all
your eggs in one basket
by assigning so many
troops to the works zone!

The vaccine production is
my number one priority. I
can't afford to allow such
rare matter to be
destroyed.

And after you have
eliminated the Thornites,
you plan to seize the
vaccine for yourself!
... What if I do? What can\nyou do about it?
Exactly! We'll stop you at\nall costs! We won't let you\ntake the vaccine!

Verda knew this was our
only chance. That a cure
for the plague was the
only way to combat you.	official
1090_060_11	c4ffdf300d8a8d6f25af51579116d694754d633d	Without the threat of the
Devil's Plague, you will lose
your control over the
people.
Bold words, but I don't see\nthe pesky child here now.
And whose fault is that!?
Thanks to your evil gun,\nVerda is...
She still thinks of you as a\nprecious member of her\nfamily.

She's desperate to
understand what you're
doing. She wants to
believe in you.
And look how you repay\nher! I can't let that go!
I don't know what she's\ntold you about me, and\nfrankly, I don't care.
I've got to do what I've got\nto do, and no one's going\nto stop me.
Wait... What are you\ndoing?
I'm on a clock here. But I\ncan eliminate you in one\nfell swoop.
How could he have been\nhiding a weapon like\nthat?
Captain, you are in mortal\ndanger! Withdraw!
You're right. We're on a\nclock, too.

Val and the others are
fighting for their lives. For
all our lives! And Verda,
too.
So this is a battle we\ncan't afford to lose!

Hah! You're outclassed
here. There's only so much
that fighting spirit can
make up for.
Grrr... You little...
Surrender!? Is that meant\nto be a joke?
It's over. Surrender and\ncall off your troops in the\nworks zone.
Urgh...
That voice...
I recognize that voice!\nAnalyzing vocal source...

Vocal source located! It is
emanating from an
underground chamber
beneath this facility!
An underground chamber?
El...dram... Are\nyou...there...?

What is that? Whose voice
is it? It's like it's
reverberating through the
whole building!
Hm? Don't you know who\nI am, young lady?
I'm Bran Kleiman. I made\nmy name in Pulse Tower\nresearch.
Bran Kleiman...?

Dr. Kleiman! I obtained his
vocal data on the planet
Pasithee.	official
1090_065_17	edf3388685f7ce1abbb7901e0c3b271f21f288cd	He is Verda's grandfather,
presumed dead!
You're alive!? Oh, Verda\nwill be dying to meet you!
Ver...da?
What? Don't tell me you\ndon't remember her!
Ver...da...?
Of course! Verda! My\nprecious granddaughter,\nVerda!
Thank goodness you\nremember now!
It was you, was it!?\nYou're the one who killed\nher, are you?
Huh? What are you...?
You're going to pay! You\nare going to pay! YOU\nARE GOING TO PAY!

The life-form in the
underground chamber is
heading your way...at high
speed!
What is happening?
You will PAY! You KILLED\nmy Verda!
This doesn't make any\nsense! How can this be\nVerda's grandfather?

Affirmative! Retreat is the
best strategy now.
Planning an escape
route...
Captain! Are you out of\nyour mind? Eldram can\nfend for himself!
You want to take me with\nyou? How whimsical.

It is likely that he is the
only person able to
explain what is happening
here.
But Captain...
Enough! If we don't move\nnow, we'll all be captured\nby that crazy thing!
Captain, let's bring Eldram\nwith us whether he likes it\nor not!
The target appears to\nhave lost our trail.
We are out of the woods!
All right then, Eldram!\nStart talking! What\nhappened to Dr. Kleiman?
Hm, the silent treatment,\nis it?

Perhaps we should wait
for Verda to regain
consciousness and ask
her?
No! Don't mention any of\nthis to Verda! Not a word!
All right, you win. I'll\nexplain.
It all started that day...

The day Dr. Kleiman went
to meet the government
to ask them to abandon
the Pulse Towers.
I tried to go after him to\nstop him doing anything\nstupid, but I was too late.
I found him on the brink of\ndeath, in a huge pool of\nblood.

Around him were
government officials
explaining loudly how the
professor had spread the
Devil's Plague.

And throngs of people
who'd been gripped with
fear looking on in delight.
The heat in the air was
nauseating.

I thought I should at least
retrieve his body, but as I
approached, that's when it
happened.

Suddenly his skin started
to rupture, like the virus
was taking hold. And his
whole body started to
swell up.
He transformed into that\nhideous form.

Then, before I had time to
even react, dozens of
people around me started
to collapse, as if they'd
been infected.

I got away as quickly as I
could and broke into the
CS control room. I froze all
of Zone A, including the
professor.

Incredible...	official
1090_070_22	63417659794a978567577a4b4f3a1914a0810ced	But what happened to
him? Why did the
professor end up that
way?
It must have been some\nsort of mutated plague\nvirus, I think.

Unlike the normal strain, it
doesn't cause death in
subjects. It can withstand
extreme cold as well.

The life-form managed to
escape from Zone A and
it started traveling to
base after base, infecting
them all.

So you started freezing
stations in an effort to
stop the virus from
spreading, correct?
Verda!
What are you doing there,\nVerda? Are your injuries\nhealed already?
Healed, yeah right! But\nshe insisted that I bring\nher here.

Medicine is my field, after
all. I'm perfectly capable
of assessing my own
health.
Anyway, what were you\njust saying about\nGrandpa?
Dammit! How much did\nyou hear?
Everything, of course.\nEavesdropping is my field,\ntoo.
Hah, you're a little rascal,\naren't you?
Just keep talking.
...I secretly managed to\nsecure the life-form.

I tried to quarantine it in a
special supercooled vault
deep underground in this
zone.
But it must have mutated\nagain and evolved further.

That vault represented
the pinnacle of our
scientific knowledge. But it
escaped without any
trouble at all.
Transference? Is that\nsomething evolution can\nbring about?
......... So...this...is\nGrandpa...?
Verda! That thing's\ndangerous! Don't go\nanywhere near it!
Grandpa! Listen! We've\nmanaged to achieve\nsomething incredible.

We've managed to create
a vaccine against the
plague! We can save
everyone now! Everyone
who's been frozen can be
brought back!

It's mainly thanks to my
friends that we were able
to make it, but I've worked
really hard at it, too.
All alone, for three long\nyears...

Are you proud of me,
Grandpa? Won't you give
me a hug and a pat on
the head like old times?
Verda!
Verda...you're... Verda...\nYour-murderers-will-PAY!
No, Grandpa! It's me!\nVerda! I'm right here!
Forget it, Verda... The\nprofessor can't hear you.
You're right, Captain. It's\nmy job to stop him! Lend\nme a hand, everyone!
Of course! Captain, this is\nthe final showdown!

By defeating this thing, we
can save Levarance. Save
the entire universe! We
cannot fail!
No mercy! Kill\nEVERYTHING!
Gyurgh...
...!? Be careful! Its body\ntissue is regenerating bit\nby bit!
It's too strong for us! We\ncan't beat the plague!
You took my family from\nme... DIE!\nRevenge-for-Verda...
Enough, Grandpa! Stop\nthis!
No! Verda! This isn't Dr.\nKleiman! It's just some\nmutated life-form!

All it knows is what it
heard about killing
everyone in the midst of
the riots when the
professor died!
It doesn't know who you\nare!
When I heard that... When I\nheard Grandpa had been\nkilled in the riots...
I started to hate\neveryone.

I couldn't make sense of
it. I even found myself
wanting to kill whoever did
it, to take revenge.
Verda...

But then I heard
Grandpa's voice, talking to
me like he always did.
"Now, now, Verda," he said.
Gyur... Gyurrrgh...
When I heard that, I felt\nthat old, familiar warmth\ninside.
Ver... Ver...da...
Grandpa? Are you trying\nto say something?
Ver... Nff...
Gyaaaaaargh!!!
Look out, Verda!
Urgh!
...!!! Eldram!

Professor... Always so
impulsive... You just do
whatever comes into your
head, don't you?
Gyuuurgh...
But what about me?\nHaving to pick up the\npieces.
What are you doing,\nEldram? What do you\nneed a gun for?
Put that thing down!
Look away, Verda.
Stopping the professor is\nmy job.
Graaandpaaa!!!
...Ngh!
Regeneration has\nstopped. Vital signs are\nfading fast...
No, Grandpa! Don't die!\nPlease don't die!
...Verda... Dry...your eyes...
Huh? Grandpa!
Hahahaha! We don't\nneed...tears...

Thank you, Verda... For
making...the vaccine...
You've...always been...my
ray of hope...

But it's thanks to them
that we have the vaccine,
Grandpa. I didn't do
anything.
Perhaps. But...I know...how\nmany nights...you stayed\nup...doing research for it...
You worked...so hard...
Oh, Grandpa...
And Eldram... I'm always\ncausing problems for you,\nit seems.
I'm the only one able to\nlook after you, that's all.
Urgh...
And...it looks like I'll be\nlooking after you...in the\nnext world...too...
No! Eldram! Not you, too!
You can't both leave me!\nI'll be all alone! Again!
Forgive me, Verda, for\nhurting you...
You still have unfinished\nbusiness.
Verda, save the planet...\nSave...the universe...
You can do it, my ray of\nhope...
Grandpa... Eldram...

The provisional
government is now in
orbit. We can relax at last.
Things are finally calming
down.
Yes. Unfortunately, there's\nnothing more we can do.

It will be down to the
people of Levarance to
carve out their own future
now.
Is this really a happy\nending?
Why would it not be?
Because of Eldram, of\ncourse!

The dictator Eldram
deliberately concealed the
existence of the vaccine
to maintain a climate of
fear.
That is what he wanted\nthe public to be told. It\nwas his final wish.
But he wasn't all bad!

That is true. The
alternative is that the
people would know what a
terrifying creature had
threatened their planet.

If that information became
public knowledge,
everyone would be
gripped by fear again.
I suppose that's true.
